title: Manifest-derived registries must be wired through SearchOptions.ReloadManifests and service.go's reload gating
answers: I added a new field to SearchOptions populated from app manifests but live updates never reach it
How do I hook a new manifest-derived registry into the live manifest watcher?
Where is the single entry point for reloading search fields and embedding config together?
body: Mechanism: pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field_manifest.go:SearchOptions.ReloadManifests(builtin, live) is the single call that reloads every manifest-derived registry (EmbeddingConfigRegistry.Reload, then ApplyManifests for SearchFields) so they stay consistent on each poll. pkg/storage/unified/sql/service.go:service.registerServer only starts the manifest-watcher subservice if any such registry on SearchOptions is non-nil, and its callback invokes ReloadManifests (not the old per-registry ApplyManifests call). Adding a new registry to resource.SearchOptions (server.go) requires: (1) constructing it in search/options.go:NewSearchOptions, (2) reloading it inside ReloadManifests, (3) including it in the non-nil check in service.go — otherwise the watcher either won't start or won't refresh the new registry on live updates.
applies: Adding any new app-manifest-derived lookup/registry consumed by unified storage search/indexing.

search: Manifest-derived registries must wire through SearchOptions.ReloadManifests (pkg/storage/unified/resource/search_field_manifest.go) and service.go's reload gating to stay consistent on each poll. SearchOptions.ReloadManifests is the single call that reloads EmbeddingConfigRegistry and applies SearchFields manifests via ApplyManifests; pkg/storage/unified/sql/service.go:registerServer only starts the manifest-watcher subservice if any registry on SearchOptions is non-nil and invokes ReloadManifests. Adding a new app-manifest-derived registry requires: (1) constructing it in pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go:NewSearchOptions, (2) reloading it inside ReloadManifests, and (3) including it in the non-nil check in service.go—otherwise the watcher won't start or won't refresh the registry on live updates. Applies to adding new app-manifest-derived lookup/registry consumed by unified storage search/indexing.
